proof_body:
by
  intro a
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨L, hL⟩ ε hε
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Metric.cauchySeq_iff.1 hL.cauchySeq ε hε
    refine ⟨N, fun m n hm hmn => ?_⟩
    rw [Finset.sum_Ico_eq_sub _ hmn, ← Real.dist_eq]
    exact hN n (hm.trans hmn) m hm
  · intro h
    apply cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete
    rw [Metric.cauchySeq_iff]
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := h ε hε
    refine ⟨N, fun m hm n hn => ?_⟩
    rcases le_total m n with hmn | hmn
    · have := hN m n hm hmn
      rwa [Finset.sum_Ico_eq_sub _ hmn, ← Real.dist_eq, dist_comm] at this
    · have := hN n m hn hmn
      rwa [Finset.sum_Ico_eq_sub _ hmn, ← Real.dist_eq] at this
target_source: ∀ a : ℕ → ℝ, (∃ L : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, a i) Filter.atTop (nhds L)) ↔ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m n, N ≤ m → m ≤ n → |∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico m n, a i| < ε
